title: ENA Composed Case v1 (v0.3.3)
description: Input shape contract for validate_contracts.validate_case(): a self-contained claim pack carrying claims, support (top-level and/or registries), evidence/root/obligation/authority registries, authority binding, and recovery transition. Structural shape only — semantic enforcement (typed resolution, registry identity rule R12, tri-state resolution, evidence existence, claim-aware obligations, positive mandate typing, obligation-status vocabulary) is performed by the validator, NOT by this schema. R12 note: for dict-form registries the dict key is the authoritative identity; an explicit inner id (support_id/obligation_id/evidence_id/root_id/grant_id) must equal the key, otherwise the registry is REGISTRY_MALFORMED; missing inner ids are backfilled from the key.

eval_time.description: Explicit evaluation date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD); caller-controlled; REQUIRED by validate_case when not passed as a parameter.

claim.description: The claim under evaluation; may reference support relations and obligations.

support_registry.description: Support relations keyed by support_id or listed with inner support_id.

evidence_registry.description: Evidence artifacts keyed by evidence_id or listed with inner evidence_id.

root_registry.description: Root provenance entries keyed by root_id or listed with inner root_id (each entry may carry actual_origin).

obligations.description: Triggered obligations keyed by obligation_id or listed with inner obligation_id. Status must be within the shipped triggered-obligation.v1.schema.json enum.

authority_registry.description: Upstream authority grants keyed by grant_id or listed with inner grant_id (each entry may carry agent/host/expires_at).

registry.description: Registry container: dict {id: artifact-object} OR array of artifact-objects. Dict entries with an explicit inner id must agree with the dict key (R12).
